_meta.description: Real GitHub pull_request webhook, action=opened. The PR's node_id is a stable GraphQL global id that is BYTE-IDENTICAL across this PR's later opened/closed/reopened/merged deliveries — so external_id must encode the action, not adopt node_id verbatim (#1). Pair with pull_request_closed.json (SAME node_id) to prove the lifecycle transitions stay distinct observations. Doc-derived; ids/logins are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.github.com/en/webhooks/webhook-events-and-payloads#pull_request (action + pull_request.node_id stable across lifecycle; X-GitHub-Event: pull_request)

headers.X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<hex hmac-sha256 of the raw body>
